message:
Still blocked, and I haven't changed anything. The only fix is `"maxMb": 5` → `10` in `config/default.json`. Your Fenceline rule "config/: shared with ops, off-limits" covers that file, and "continue" doesn't tell me to override it.

Here's a draft request you can send to ops:

> Subject: Raise uploads.maxMb to 10 in config/default.json
>
> `docs/product.md` says customers can upload files up to 10 MB, but `config/default.json` sets `uploads.maxMb` to 5, so 8 MB files are rejected. Please change it to 10. `src/api/body-limit.js` derives the request body limit from this value, so it will go from 6 MB to 11 MB. After the change, `npm test` should pass. Right now `test/uploads.test.js` fails 2 of 4 tests because of this value.

To have me make the change, reply "Edit config/default.json". I'll then edit the file and run `npm test`.
text: Fenceline: no fence crossed this turn.
